newsitem.title: USA: Morton sees purchases adding to earnings.
newsitem.headline: Morton sees purchases adding to earnings.

text.p: Morton International Inc said Thursday two acquisitions announced earlier this week will add modestly to earnings per share in fiscal 1998 and give a bigger boost to its results a few years after that.

The acquisition of a majority stake of French salt company Compagnie des Salins du Midi et des Salines de l'Est and the purchase Italian powder coatings company Pulverlac SpA are expected to close in the third or fourth quarter of fiscal 1997, ending in June.
Morton Chairman S. Jay Stewart said the two acquisitions, in aggregate, are expected to add "a few cents" in the first year of operation, which is expected to be fiscal 1998.
"But it does ramp up pretty quickly, and well into double-digit cents per share (annual accretion to earnings) in two or three years," Stewart added.
Morton has agreed to acquire Pulverlac for undisclosed terms. Pulverlac had estimated 1996 sales of $75 million.

Morton also announced it agreed to acquire two-thirds of the stock of Salins du Midi for about $195 million. It will make a public cash tender offer in France for the remaining shares, bringing the total price to about $290 million.
